new_rules.title: Cambridge Chapter 8.80 - Rental Application Fee Protections
new_rules.requirement: Landlords, property managers and agents may not charge, accept or require any rental application fee, screening fee or holding fee from a prospective tenant of a covered dwelling unit. Applies to residential rental buildings with six or more dwelling units.
new_rules.key_value: Application, screening and holding fees prohibited (cap = $0) in buildings with 6+ units
new_rules.citation: Cambridge Ordinance No. 2026-T1, Cambridge Municipal Code ch. 8.80
new_rules.conflict_note: The document is labeled a fictional test document, not a real law.
new_rules.quoted_span: No landlord, property manager or agent shall charge, accept or require any rental application fee, screening fee or holding fee from a prospective tenant of a dwelling unit subject to this chapter.
